seasonLine: Warm, dusty colors with little contrast sit closest to your skin.

wear.name: Oat
wear.why: Oat is a warm light neutral, softer on you than a bright white.

wear.name: Mahogany
wear.why: Mahogany is as dark as your coloring goes without breaking it.

wear.name: Taupe
wear.why: A grey brown is the neutral that matches your muted warmth.

wear.name: Clay
wear.why: Clay is a warm red brown at the softness your skin carries.

wear.name: Soft gold
wear.why: Soft gold picks up the warmth in your skin without shouting.

wear.name: Olive
wear.why: Olive is warm and muted, which is where your coloring sits.

wear.name: Sage
wear.why: A green with grey in it keeps your contrast low, the way it is.

wear.name: Teal
wear.why: Teal is the cool color that still holds warmth, so it works on you.

wear.name: Denim blue
wear.why: Denim blue is dusty rather than clear, which suits your coloring.

wear.name: Dusty rose
wear.why: Dusty rose is a warm pink with grey in it, close to your skin.

avoid.name: Icy blue
avoid.why: Icy blue is cold and clear next to your muted warmth.

avoid.name: Pure white
avoid.why: Pure white is a harder edge than your soft coloring wants.

avoid.name: Hot pink
avoid.why: Hot pink is brighter and colder than anything in your coloring.

avoid.name: Black
avoid.why: Black makes a contrast your face does not have on its own.

avoid.name: Bright turquoise
avoid.why: Bright turquoise is clear and cold beside your dusty warmth.
